reserveReview.rationale: Renewal from the issuer transparency page (reached through the collateral link, accessed 2026-11-19), whose reserve disclosure is dated October 20, 2026: the GGBR Trust holds 1,000,000 troy ounces of Happy 2 in-situ gold for the beneficiaries of all 25,000,000 GGBR outstanding (approximately 40:1; the supply observation is separately dated October 27, 2026), unchanged since the September 4, 2026 review. The issuer discloses no other asset in the trust's reserve book, so the full book remains the single in-situ gold slice at 100%; no split was computed. The issuer's risk disclosures also describe trust holdings of digital assets and cash without reconciling them to this figure, so confidence is probable, not verified. I-ON Digital's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was not filed by its November 16, 2026 due date (Form 12b-25 per EDGAR-tracked coverage). The executed trust agreement, transfer and title instruments and geological report remain unpublished. The slice keeps its conservative high risk tier.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Goldfish transparency reserve disclosure dated October 20, 2026: Happy 2 in-situ gold claims held by GGBR Trust for GGBR holders
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: GGBR Inc. and the issuer-disclosed trustee Le Petit Bouffant, Ltd are identified. I-ON Digital's June 30, 2026 filing documents the historical ION.au lease intermediary; the issuer's September 9 release announces its replacement effective August 19 by the GGBR Trust. The risk disclosures re-read 2026-11-19 still state the Issuer holds only asset-backed digital assets and a very small amount of cash, which the issuer has not reconciled with the trust's in-situ gold. I-ON Digital's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was not filed by its November 16, 2026 due date, so no current intermediary filing exists. The executed trust deed, title-transfer evidence, any remaining upstream custody allocation, legal enforceability and reconciliation remain unresolved. This review does not infer a different reserve allocation percentage.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer's September 9, 2026 release names Le Petit Bouffant, Ltd as trustee and says an August 19 trust restructuring replaced the prior lease-based intermediary. The executed trust agreement, trustee certification, title/lien records and underlying geological report were not obtained; issuer-described independence, segregation, bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation protections are not independently established. I-ON Digital's June 30, 2026 Form 10-Q, filed August 19, describes the earlier lease of up to 1,000,000 ION.au digital assets with retained ownership and/or management control. This historical filing does not prove that I-ON remains a current custody provider after the announced restructuring. The support page still references ION.au, and July 31, 2025 risk disclosures describe digital assets and cash. Current title, any remaining upstream custody and the transition instruments remain unresolved.
